about: 7 Wonders Duel Pantheon: the 5 Grand Temples, Age III cards with their own card back (docs/spec-pantheon.md R6). 3 of them replace the Guilds each game. Free while holding a Mythology token of the Temple's Mythology (R9); 5 / 12 / 21 VP for 1 / 2 / 3 built. Costs from docs/research/expansions.md Part A, section 3. Card game facts (c) Repos Production.

format.mythology: the Mythology whose token makes the Temple free
format.points: end-of-game VP for 1, 2 and 3 Grand Temples built
